data.summary: “The most heartbreaking day in NFL history. 😭💔” has pulled 12,277,759 views at ~32,193/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a story-time whose strongest lever is thumbnail. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: A high-contrast thumbnail with a clear focal subject likely lifts the initial tap rate against a busy Shorts feed.
The framing targets a broad, relatable everyday situation, which likely widens the share-and-comment audience.
Views are accumulating far faster than a typical upload, and that early velocity likely compounds into broader recommendation.
A tight, fast cold-open with the payoff up front likely sustains the watch-through that Shorts distribution favors.
The first second of the title promises a clear, specific payoff, which likely earns the early swipe-through that short-form distribution rewards.
